text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after sizable gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on my plan rather than the pleasure of locking in a gain.","Avoid letting the pain of selling at a loss keep me from reviewing a position objectively; holding without reassessing did not prevent my account value from falling.","With prices moving randomly, recent performance is not a reliable forecast, so I should avoid frequent reactive trades and make deliberate decisions using my goals and risk limits."]}
